Law: Law of the People's Republic of China on Public Security Administration Penalties
Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Repeatedly harassing, forcibly begging, or disturbing others
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or warning

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Repeatedly sending obscene, insulting, threatening or other messages that interfere with normal life
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Peeping, secretly photographing, eavesdropping, or spreading others' privacy
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Abandoning dependents who cannot live independently
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or warning

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Impersonating, concealing, destroying, privately opening or illegally inspecting others' mail
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Hotel Staff
Behavior: Failing to register guests' names, ID types and numbers according to regulations
Consequence: Fine of 200-500 yuan

Subject: Housing Lessors
Behavior: Renting housing to persons without ID or failing to register tenants' names, ID types and numbers
Consequence: Fine of 200-500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Violating noise pollution prevention laws, creating noise disturbing others' normal life
Consequence: Warning; if not corrected after warning, fine of 200-500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Taking others' motor vehicles without permission
Consequence: Fine of 500-1000 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 10-15 days and fine of 500-1000 yuan

Subject: Animal Keepers
Behavior: Keeping animals that disturb others' normal life
Consequence: Warning; if not corrected or allowing animals to frighten others, fine of 200-500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Disturbing order at stations, ports, airports, shopping malls, parks, exhibition halls or other public places
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Disturbing order on buses, trams, trains, ships, aircraft or other public transportation
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Throwing objects into venues and ignoring stop orders
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Chasing or intercepting others
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 10-15 days with possible fine up to 1000 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Forcibly taking or arbitrarily damaging/occupying public or private property
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 10-15 days with possible fine up to 1000 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Unauthorized entry into railway protective nets or walking/sitting/lying on railway tracks when trains approach
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan

Subject: Construction Units or Individuals
Behavior: Not providing covers, barriers or warning signs for ditches/wells/pits in vehicle or pedestrian areas, or intentionally damaging/moving such protection
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Publicly insulting others or fabricating facts to defame others
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Beating others or intentionally causing bodily harm
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days and fine of 200-500 yuan; for minor cases, detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Forcing others to buy or sell goods, provide services or accept services
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days and fine of 200-500 yuan; for minor cases, detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Theft, fraud, looting, robbery, extortion or intentional damage to public or private property
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 10-15 days with possible fine up to 1000 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Refusing to execute government decisions or orders issued under emergency situations
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Obstructing state functionaries in performing their duties
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Obstructing emergency vehicles like fire trucks, ambulances, engineering emergency vehicles, police cars
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Impersonating state functionaries or using other false identities to deceive
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan; for minor cases, detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Carving, defacing or intentionally damaging state-protected cultural relics or historic sites
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days and fine of 200-500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Providing conditions for gambling for profit, or participating in gambling with significant stakes
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 10-15 days and fine of 500-3000 yuan

Subject: Industry Staff
Behavior: Staff of hotels, catering, entertainment, taxi services tipping off offenders during police investigation of drug use, gambling, prostitution
Consequence: Detention for 10-15 days

Subject: Intoxicated Persons
Behavior: Intoxicated person posing danger to self or threat to others' personal safety, property or public safety
Consequence: Protective restraint until sobered up

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Disturbing order of government agencies, organizations, enterprises, causing work, production, business, medical care, teaching, research unable to proceed normally
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Illegally intercepting or forcibly boarding/hitching rides on motor vehicles, ships, aircraft or other transport vehicles
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Forcibly entering venues and disturbing order at cultural, sports and other mass events
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Setting off fireworks or other items in venues against regulations, disturbing order at cultural, sports and other mass events
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Displaying insulting banners, slogans or other items, disturbing order at cultural, sports and other mass events
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Surrounding and attacking referees, athletes or other staff, disturbing order at cultural, sports and other mass events
Consequence: Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Spreading rumors, falsely reporting dangers, epidemics, police situations or using other methods to intentionally disturb public order
Consequence: Detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan; for minor cases, detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Installing or using electric nets without approval, or installing/using electric nets not complying with safety regulations
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Stealing, damaging road manhole covers, lighting and other public facilities
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Venue Management Staff
Behavior: Management staff of hotels, restaurants, theaters, entertainment venues, sports venues, exhibition halls or other public venues refusing to correct safety violations after police orders
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Fabricating facts to falsely accuse others, attempting to subject others to criminal prosecution or security administration penalties
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Citizens
Behavior: Threatening, insulting, beating or retaliating against witnesses or their close relatives
Consequence: Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Hotel Staff
Behavior: Hotel staff knowing guests are criminal suspects or wanted by police and failing to report to police
Consequence: Fine of 200-500 yuan; for serious cases, detention up to 5 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

Subject: Responsible Person
Behavior: As supervisor, failing to take necessary precautions for animal supervision
Consequence: Fine

Consequence: Fine up to 1000 euros

Consequence: Fine corresponding to the offense committed while intoxicated

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Creating noise without justifiable cause that is likely to disturb the general public
Consequence: Fine up to 5000 euros

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Performing a grossly improper act that impairs public order
Consequence: Fine

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Publicly calling for commission of an administrative offense in an assembly or through distribution of content

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Behaving in public in a way likely to harass others

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Distributing or making publicly accessible content in a grossly offensive manner

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Unauthorized wearing of professional dress or badge of religious association
Consequence: Fine

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Manufacturing plates, molds, printing blocks for producing money without written permission

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Joining or not leaving a public gathering after three lawful orders to disperse

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Intentionally or negligently entering military facility or installation contrary to prohibition
Consequence: Fine

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Transmitting items or messages to or from a prisoner
Consequence: Fine

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Producing or distributing printed materials that could be confused with currency
Consequence: Fine up to 10000 euros

Subject: Offender
Behavior: Allowing dangerous wild animal or vicious animal to roam freely

Consequence: Fine

Behavior: Violating orders

Behavior: Compensation obligation for financial damage caused by prosecution measure in administrative offense proceedings

Behavior: Unlawfully entering another's dwelling
